compact.help: Asks it to save first: “I'm about to compact this conversation. Check in, push, or save anything else you need before I complete compaction, and then I will let you know when to resume.”
compact.label: Compact

deferral.help: Don't ask again until this session compacts
deferral.label: Not Now

ask.help: I'm about to compact this conversation. Check in, push, or save anything else you need before I complete compaction, and then I will let you know when to resume.

hide.help: Hide until it asks again (the menu can show it)
hide.label: Close

ask.text: Compact this session? It saves its work first. It's idle, so it starts when it next runs.

turnOff.help: Stop asking and stop compacting by itself until you turn Context Guard back on
turnOff.label: Turn Off
